cards.card_text: Peter says Jesus was delivered up by a set plan and foreknowledge.
cards.verse_text: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death by nailing Him to the cross.
cards.snippet: He was delivered up by God’s set plan and foreknowledge, and you, by the hands of the lawless, put Him to death…

cards.card_text: Peter says these exiles were chosen according to the foreknowledge of God the Father.
cards.verse_text: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father and sanctified by the Spirit for obedience to Jesus Christ and sprinkling by His blood: Grace and peace be yours in abundance.
